blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — A magnitude 5.1 earthquake that jolted Antique on Wednesday morning led to the suspension of classes in several municipalities in Iloilo and the evacuation of students, government workers, and individuals transacting at public offices. The evacuations were ordered as authorities conducted inspections of buildings to check for possible structural damage. Based on […]...
